cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, create a slurry by whisking together water with cornstarch. Then add chili-garlic sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil and whisk together. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp cold water
3 tsp cornstarch
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
6 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the eggplants and green onions. Medium dice the eggplant; transfer to a bowl. Trim ends and cut the onions on an angle into 1 ¼ cm pieces; transfer to another bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium eggplants
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Transfer both to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice the pork chops into bite-sized strips and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork and stir-fry until browned, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Once pork has been removed, add more oil to the skillet. Add the eggplant and stir-fry until lightly browned and softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet. Stir fry with the eggplant for 1-2 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet and add the green onions and sauce. Toss until the ingredients are well combined and sauce is thickened, about 1 minute.
Cut the lime into wedges for serving.
Serve stir fry in a bowl, squeeze lime juice over top, and enjoy!
